lat: rje3t l d-dar m3a t-tlata

lat: hiya ma rej3atsh l l-khdma

lat: d-drari ma rej3ush l l-qism

en: Do you return home by bus?

lat: nta ma katrje3sh bekri f l-3shiya

lat: wash katrej3i l l-khdma daba
en: Are you returning to work now?

lat: nti ma katrej3ish l d-dar bekri

lat: huwa kayrje3 l l-khedma f l-weqt

lat: huwa ma kayrje3sh l d-dar l-yum

lat: khti ma katrje3sh l l-khedma daba

lat: ntuma ma katrej3ush l l-khedma f s-sebt

lat: l-kheddama ma kayrej3ush l d-dar daba

lat: ma ghadish nrje3 l had l-blasa

lat: wash ghadi trej3i l d-dar bekri

lat: mmi ghadi trje3 l d-dar f l-3shiya

lat: hiya ma ghadish trje3 l l-khedma l-yum
